visualCharacteristics.purpose: e-mail newsletter sign-up form: one e-mail field and a submit button

contentPattern.structure: one cell (or rows): optional heading/intro text; paragraph with the field placeholder (trailing * = required); link whose text is the button label and href the POST endpoint; optional paragraph after the link = success message, next = error message

reuseGuidance: Use for inline e-mail capture. The endpoint must accept a POST with form field "email"; until one is configured authors can use # to show the success message only.
